args.title: Fix issue 4402 in src/util/money.ts
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The parseAmount function in src/util/money.ts strips only certain currency symbols (€, $, £, ¥) but does not recognize or remove the Indian rupee sign (₹) or other currency codes as prefixes. Amounts like '₹1,250.00' fail the numeric regex test and return null, causing 'The amount is not a number' error. To fix, parseAmount should be extended to recognize and remove the rupee sign and possibly other currency prefixes before parsing the number.
